        var input = JsonUtil.fromJson(inputJson, ExtractInput.class);
        var configJson = "{}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ExtractionConfig.class);
        var result = Xberg.extractWithExternalRedaction(input, config, "[{\"entity_type\":\"inspection_person\",\"start\":0,\"end\":3,\"score\":0.99,\"analysis_explanation\":{\"recognizer\":\"spacy\"}}]", null, 8);
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).content());
    }
}
